__metaDescription: View an apprentice's weekly training record and approve it or send it back — no account, no sign-up. The week travels inside the link itself; nothing is uploaded.

abIntro.ausbildungsnachweis_ansehen_und_freigebe: View and approve a training record
abIntro.diese_seite_zeigt_eine_einzelne: This page shows a single weekly training record from an apprentice so you can approve it or send it back for revision. You do not need an account and nothing needs installing.
abIntro.ihr_azubi_zeigt_ihnen_einen: Your apprentice shows you a QR code or sends you a link.
abIntro.sie_lesen_die_woche_hier: You read the week here and tap Approve or Send back.
abIntro.sie_erhalten_einen_kurzen_antwortcode: You get a short response code that your apprentice scans with their phone camera. Your decision then appears in their training record.
abIntro.die_woche_steckt_im_link: The week is contained in the link itself. It is not transmitted to a server and is not stored anywhere — the part of an address after the hash mark never leaves the device.
abIntro.ohne_einen_solchen_link_hat: Without such a link this page has nothing to display.

abErrText.bitte_lassen_sie_sich_den: Please ask for the link again. It may have been cut short when it was copied.
